protocol: IEEE-CIS paired XGBoost and TreeSHAP benchmark
sampling: without replacement from 13,361 common held-out TransactionIDs, no class balancing; same ordered IDs across both cases
scenario_A: batch slicing, ordered prepared-input adapter, XGBoost probabilities
scenario_B: scenario A plus TreeSHAP for every transaction

analysis.bootstrap: 5000 percentile resamples, seed42; pointwise mean-difference CI
analysis.cross_model_comparison: descriptive pattern consistency only; training protocols and feature sets differ

limitations: public mirror not byte-verified against official Kaggle download
source history fallback uses global amount median
prepared-feature timing excludes full raw pipeline
sequential blocks and one host limit generalization
different training splits and feature sets prevent causal attribution of between-model differences
no verified journal publication or explicit repository license for FraudLens; usage terms remain to be clarified
supplemental_metrics: process CPU time seconds, not an additional hypothesis family

quality_review.threshold_role: descriptive review, not automatic removal or proof of validity

cpu_clock.resolution: recorded per worker, not assumed to equal accuracy
